names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 mai, «Sfântul Cuvios Teodor cel Sfințit».

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 16. мај ст. ст., „Преподобни Теодор Освештани.“ Преподобни is the venerable rank, which this corpus puts in `types`; strip it and the fuller form is left. **Освештани is kept**: it is the epithet „the Sanctified“ that this folder's own display name carries and not a rank — doxologia's life devotes a whole appended note to arguing why he is called it — and keeping it is also what saves this folder from the bare «Теодор» that four other folders now share. Measured before drafting with `foldchk.py`: no folder in the corpus holds this form in any language.

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion 16/5 the Romanian row already carries, so nothing moved. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NO `dates` OBJECT**: „Упокојио се мирно и преселио у царство вечне светлости 368. године“ → `death` 368. **No other book read for this folder gives a year at all** — doxologia's life ends „he went to the Lord in deep old age“ and the folder has never had a `dates` object — so there is nothing to widen and nothing to reconcile. **THE TWO BOOKS CONTRADICT EACH OTHER ON HIS BIRTH AND NEITHER IS CHOSEN.** The Prologue opens „Рођен и одрастао као незнабожац, но као младић дошао до познања праве вере, крстио се“ — born and raised a heathen, come to the faith as a young man and then baptised — where doxologia has him „born of rich and honoured Christian parents“ with his first zeal kindled at fourteen at a feast kept in their house on 6 January. **This is a real disagreement and not a gap**, it concerns no year, and the added paragraph says both and chooses neither; nothing in `dates` or `types` turns on it. **New here**: that he **fled to Pachomius secretly from his parents**; that Pachomius tonsured him and loved him for his uncommon zeal and obedience; that **when his mother came to call him home he would not even show himself to her** but prayed that God would enlighten her — and that **she neither took her son home nor went home herself, but entered the women's monastery nearby that Pachomius's own sister governed, and was tonsured**; that **his own brother came after a time and was tonsured too**; that **the bishop of Панопољ asked Pachomius for a monastery** and Pachomius took Theodore along and gave him the chief charge of building it; and that **after Pachomius's death he became abbot of all Pachomius's monasteries**. **Two people named and neither gains a folder, by the coordinator's third ruling.** His brother is named „Пафнутије“ — **the same Пафнутије the 15 May entry lists among Pachomius's ten disciples**, and still with nothing to tell him from the corpus's several Paphnutius folders, so he is in the prose as „his own brother“ and not by name. Pachomius's sister is **not named in the entry at all**, which is also why the day's verse on 15 May, which is about her, named her only as „Сестра Авве“. **Petronius, whom doxologia puts between Pachomius and Theodore, is absent from this entry**; nothing is claimed against doxologia on it. `types` untouched: Преподобни is the `venerable` the folder carries and „поста игуманом“ is the `abbot` it carries. No `locations`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Locuitor pustiului şi înger în trup şi de minuni făcător te-ai arătat, purtătorule de Dumnezeu, părintele nostru Teodor; cu postul, cu privegherea, cu rugăciunea, cereşti daruri luând, vindeci pe cei bolnavi şi sufletele celor ce aleargă la tine cu credinţă. Slavă Celui ce ţi-a dat ţie putere; slavă Celui ce te-a încununat pe tine; Slavă Celui ce lucrează prin tine tuturor tămăduiri.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Teodor cel Sfințit», Glasul 1

english.text: A dweller of the desert and an angel in the body and a worker of wonders wast thou shown to be, our God-bearing father Theodore; receiving heavenly gifts by fasting, by vigil and by prayer, thou healest the sick and the souls of those who run to thee with faith. Glory to Him who gave thee strength; glory to Him who crowned thee; glory to Him who works healings for all through thee.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 16. мај ст. ст.: „Упокојио се мирно и преселио у царство вечне светлости 368. године.“ This folder held no `dates` object at all until now, and no other calendar read for it gives a year: doxologia's life closes with „deep old age“ and no number, and the Greek and Russian rows are undocumented. No year of birth is given by either book.
